title: Thinking Differently
coreMove: Break the stale mental pattern that has become part of the obstacle, then test a disciplined non-default route.
sourcePressure: This chapter belongs to Perception, so it must teach cleaner seeing before it teaches action or endurance. Source sidecar ch08 exists and provides partial-source support only; no full text is frozen. For "Thinking Differently", the pressure is to teach this exact move: Break the stale mental pattern that has become part of the obstacle, then test a disciplined non-default route.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The weak version turns the chapter into generic mindset advice instead of a precise discipline of reading the obstacle cleanly. For "Thinking Differently", avoid replacing the chapter move with the whole book thesis.

hook: A generic obstacle appears and teaches thinking differently
The problem is not the problem
Everything changed when the setback arrived
counterintuition: The obstacle is actually a blessing
The hard part is really your mindset
tryThisNow: Set a timer and reflect on adversity
Write down three things you are grateful for
Take a breath and choose courage
